verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Payroll's pricing docs say you can run payroll by 5:00 PM to pay employees the next business day, or by 7:00 AM for same-day pay. They also confirm paychecks go by direct deposit and that employees can enter their own deposit details, which covers fast direct deposit in place of checks. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of deposit speed, and clear documentation of which plan tiers include next-day versus same-day deposit.

support.subject: As a founder, I can pay employees by fast (next-day or 2-day) direct deposit instead of writing checks
